en.name: Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-
en.effect: Discard 1 "Power Patron" card; place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zone, then if it is a Fusion Monster, you can place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone. If you control a "Power Patron" monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK, also it cannot attack this turn. You can only use each effect of "Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-" once per turn.

zh-CN.name: 狱神封门－共灭之剑－
zh-CN.effect: 此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：从手牌将1张“狱神”卡舍弃可以发动。从额外牌组将1只“狱神”灵摆怪兽放在自己的灵摆区域。以此效果放了融合怪兽的情况下，进而可从牌组将1只“狱神”灵摆怪兽放在自己的灵摆区域。②：自己场上存在“狱神”怪兽的情况下，将墓地的此卡除外，以场上的1只表侧表示怪兽为对象可以发动。该怪兽攻击力上升1500，此回合不可攻击。
